description: DONE (b5b341bff, two-lane audited PASS/PASS 2026-07-03). Owning-symbol extraction is now a SINGLE accessor, TransportPosition::executable (src/compiler2/transport.rs:285, a 7-variant or-pattern returning &ExecutableSymbol, exhaustive — no wildcard, so a future variant forces a compile error rather than silent mis-extraction). Three hand-rolled duplicate matches routed through it: jobs/transport.rs::executable_key_for_transport_position (kept its ActivationKey::from_inputs + need layering, replaced just the match); transport_contract_test.rs:4074 inline match; transport_contract_test.rs position_executable helper (deleted, sole caller inlined). Identity proven byte-for-byte before replacing (same borrowed type, no clone added/dropped; the one differently-ordered copy is harmless — or-patterns are order-independent). Ride-along: pull.rs doc comment 'replacing the per-production filter-scan' -> 'avoiding' (migration narration -> present-tense fact, comment-only). Net -27 lines. Sweep confirmed the remaining full-variant matches (transport_position_sort_key, artifact.rs/backend.rs seam+sort-key matches) carry genuinely different per-arm logic, not pure extraction — left as-is; two follow-ups filed for adjacent redundancy.
title: Unify the hand-rolled owning-symbol matches onto TransportPosition::executable
